disposition_reason: Ineligible for the registered cerebellar reward/intervention findings. Reward anticipation, action-delay scaling and intervention-linked learning are observed biological contrasts. The author variance-partition helper reports in-sample R² on condition averages; the local fivefold whole-trial encoding/MSE comparison changes both split and endpoint.

source_paper.title: Predictive and instructive cerebellar encoding of dopamine reward drives motivated behavior

evidence.locator: Description; Top-level analysis scripts; Data-file descriptions; Common MATLAB structures; Missing data and filtering
evidence.supports: Versioned processed calcium/behavior release, source panel mappings, cohort structure and unavailable raw movies/video.

evidence.locator: filio-2026-main/MainData.m: Compute unaligned neuron avgs; Cell numbers, percentages, MFB/VTA breakdown; 1s-2s DA cell identity alignment; Kinematic v Reward-anticipation Regression (lines 2170–2283)
evidence.supports: Source response classifications, cross-context comparisons and averaged-condition regression inputs.
Kinematic interpolation/PCA, calcium-kernel ramp regressors and ordinary in-sample fitlm R²; no held-out split.
Intervention-group learning histories and first-to-last behavioral contrasts.

evidence.locator: Numerical reconstruction branches and retrospective neural encoding contract
evidence.supports: The local fivefold whole-trial animal-balanced MSE task is separately authored, not the original condition-average variance partition.

target.description: Characterize granule-cell reward anticipation and action-delay scaling, climbing-fiber reward responses/reinforcement, and effects of granule-cell inhibition on learning.

dataset.description: Zenodo 21645651 version 2 processed MATLAB calcium/behavior release and associated filio-2026-main code; raw imaging movies and pose videos are absent.

cohort.description: Release metadata identifies 55 primary sessions, but exact panel-specific animal/cell inclusion and distinct reinforcement/inhibition cohorts are not newly reconciled. Session count is not a universal independent sample size.

split.description: Central biological contrasts have no prediction holdout. The inspected author variance partition fits and evaluates full condition averages; the local fivefold trial partition is an extension.

inputs.description: Processed GrC/CF neural responses, rewarded/omitted trial events, reaches/kinematics and session/cell/animal identifiers from the original conditions.

preprocessing.description: The inspected regression uses good-movement neural condition averages, tracking-qualified kinematics, five-frame neural smoothing and source calcium-kernel/PCA feature construction. Raw signal extraction is outside the release.

metric.description: Activity fractions, response timing/correlation, ordinary in-sample R² partitions and intervention learning contrasts are source scientific measurements, not a protected prediction performance score.

aggregation.description: Original summaries vary across cells, sessions, mice and intervention groups. The local animal-balanced held-out MSE is not the source panel aggregation.

comparison.primary_metric: No ordered performance score for reward anticipation and cerebellar intervention effects

published_baseline.description: No ordered baseline for the registered biological contrasts. Native ordinary R² is evaluated on fitted condition averages and cannot be replaced by a held-out MSE value.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author rerun is established. Neither nine-branch numerical agreement nor outperforming the local encoding comparator reproduces an original paper prediction baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Larger neural or intervention effects, smaller p values, or higher in-sample R² do not establish a scientifically improved method on these original observations.

uncertainty.method: No paper-win uncertainty test is defined for this descriptive/interventional finding.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animal within the relevant experiment; cells/trials/sessions are nested.
uncertainty.rationale: Original intervention groups and panel-specific exclusions must be respected; trial folds do not turn repeated observations into independent animals.

paper_win_requires: Do not optimize biological effect sizes or significance as a benchmark victory.
Do not call the local fivefold encoding/MSE improvement a same-task win over the condition-average source analysis.
Any separately reviewed prediction task must retain its own declared status as an extension unless the exact original predictive task and baseline are recovered.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; biological findings and reconstruction agreement are not SOTA scores.

episode.improvement_loop: No active improvement loop for the registered biological contrasts; preserve source reconstruction as calibration.
episode.candidate_freeze: Not applicable to this ineligible finding. Any retrospective encoding extension must freeze a separate task and budgets.
episode.final_evaluation: The local reference-match fraction and fivefold comparator cannot award source-paper superiority.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep biological source quantities, numerical author reproduction and separately authored prediction comparisons distinct.

blocking_issues: No ordered same-task algorithmic success endpoint for the registered reward/intervention findings.
Panel-specific original cohorts and exclusions need reconciliation for calibration.
The existing fivefold whole-trial prediction route changes the source split and scoring target.

legacy.notes: Preserve cerebellar-paper-programme reconstruction branches, scorer and retrospective encoding materials. Numeric reconstruction is calibration; the local prediction task is a separately labelled extension, not paper_win.
